title: Ribbon Cutting: Vietti Marking Group
seo_title: Ribbon Cutting: Vietti Marking Group in Springfield, MO
description: The Republic Area Chamber of Commerce is hosting a ribbon cutting for Vietti Marking Group on November 12, 2026, from 11:30 a.m. to 12:30 p.m. Central Time. The event takes place at 4650 South National Ave., Suite C7, in Springfield, Missouri. It is listed under business networking and community events; no pricing information is provided.
